role.blood-on-the-blocktower.norole.abil: null role used to unassign a player's role.
role.blood-on-the-blocktower.chef.abilit: You start knowing how many pairs of evil players there are.
role.blood-on-the-blocktower.investigato: You start knowing that 1 of 2 players is a particular Minion.
role.blood-on-the-blocktower.washerwoman: You start knowing that 1 of 2 players is a particular Townsfolk.
role.blood-on-the-blocktower.librarian.a: You start knowing that 1 of 2 players is a particular Outsider. (Or that zero are in play.)
role.blood-on-the-blocktower.empath.abil: Each night, you learn how many of your 2 alive neighbors are evil.
role.blood-on-the-blocktower.fortunetell: Each night, choose 2 players: you learn if either is a Demon. There is a good player that registers as a Demon to you.
Each night*, you learn which character died by execution today.
role.blood-on-the-blocktower.monk.abilit: Each night*, choose a player (not yourself): they are safe from the Demon tonight.
role.blood-on-the-blocktower.slayer.abil: Once per game, during the day, publicly choose a player: if they are the Demon, they die.
role.blood-on-the-blocktower.soldier.abi: You are safe from the Demon.
role.blood-on-the-blocktower.ravenkeeper: If you die at night, you are woken to choose a player: you learn their character.
role.blood-on-the-blocktower.virgin.abil: The 1st time you are nominated, if the nominator is a Townsfolk, they are executed immediately.
role.blood-on-the-blocktower.mayor.abili: If only 3 players live & no execution occurs, your team wins. If you die at night, another player might die instead.
role.blood-on-the-blocktower.grandmother: You start knowing a good player & their character. If the Demon kills them, you die too.
role.blood-on-the-blocktower.sailor.abil: Each night, choose an alive player: either you or they are drunk until dusk. You can't die.
role.blood-on-the-blocktower.chambermaid: Each night, choose 2 alive players (not yourself): you learn how many woke tonight due to their ability.
role.blood-on-the-blocktower.innkeeper.a: Each night*, choose 2 players: they can't die tonight, but 1 is drunk until dusk.
role.blood-on-the-blocktower.gambler.abi: Each night*, choose a player & guess their character: if you guess wrong, you die.
role.blood-on-the-blocktower.exorcist.ab: Each night*, choose a player (different to last night): the Demon, if chosen, learns who you are then doesn't wake tonight.
role.blood-on-the-blocktower.gossip.abil: Each day, you may make a public statement. Tonight, if it was true, a player dies.
role.blood-on-the-blocktower.courtier.ab: Once per game, at night, choose a character: they are drunk for 3 nights & 3 days.
role.blood-on-the-blocktower.professor.a: Once per game, at night*, choose a dead player: if they are a Townsfolk, they are resurrected.
role.blood-on-the-blocktower.minstrel.ab: When a Minion dies by execution, all other players are drunk until dusk tomorrow.
role.blood-on-the-blocktower.tealady.abi: If both your alive neighbors are good, they can't die.
role.blood-on-the-blocktower.fool.abilit: The 1st time you die, you don't.
role.blood-on-the-blocktower.pacifist.ab: Executed good players might not die.
You start knowing how many steps from the Demon to its nearest Minion.
role.blood-on-the-blocktower.dreamer.abi: Each night, choose a player (not yourself): you learn 1 good & 1 evil character, 1 of which is correct.
role.blood-on-the-blocktower.snakecharme: Each night, choose an alive player: a chosen Demon swaps characters & alignments with you & is then poisoned.
role.blood-on-the-blocktower.mathematici: Each night, you learn how many players' abilities worked abnormally (since dawn) due to another character's ability.
Each night*, you learn if a Demon voted today.
role.blood-on-the-blocktower.towncrier.a: Each night*, you learn if a Minion nominated today.
role.blood-on-the-blocktower.oracle.abil: Each night*, you learn how many dead players are evil.
role.blood-on-the-blocktower.savant.abil: Each night, you learn 2 things in private: 1 is true & 1 is false.
Once per game, at night, choose 2 players (not yourself): you learn if they are the same alignment.
role.blood-on-the-blocktower.philosopher: Once per game, at night, choose a good character: gain that ability. If this character is in play, they are drunk.
role.blood-on-the-blocktower.artist.abil: Once per game, at night, ask the Storyteller any yes/no question.
role.blood-on-the-blocktower.juggler.abi: On your 1st day, publicly guess up to 5 players' characters. That night, you learn how many you got correct.
role.blood-on-the-blocktower.sage.abilit: If the Demon kills you, you learn that it is 1 of 2 players.
role.blood-on-the-blocktower.noble.abili: You start knowing 3 players, 1 and only 1 of which is evil.
role.blood-on-the-blocktower.pixie.abili: You start knowing 1 in-play Townsfolk. If you were mad that you were this character, you gain their ability when they die.
role.blood-on-the-blocktower.general.abi: Each night, you learn which alignment the Storyteller believes is winning: good, evil, or neither.
role.blood-on-the-blocktower.king.abilit: Each night, if the dead equal or outnumber the living, you learn 1 alive character. The Demon knows you are the King.
role.blood-on-the-blocktower.lycanthrope: Each night*, choose an alive player. If good, they die & the Demon doesn't kill tonight. One good player registers as evil.
role.blood-on-the-blocktower.engineer.ab: Once per game, at night, choose which Minions or which Demon is in play.
role.blood-on-the-blocktower.huntsman.ab: Once per game, at night, choose a living player: the Damsel, if chosen, becomes a not-in-play Townsfolk. [+the Damsel]
role.blood-on-the-blocktower.alchemist.a: You have a Minion ability. When using this, the Storyteller may prompt you to choose differently.
role.blood-on-the-blocktower.cannibal.ab: You have the ability of the recently killed executee. If they are evil, you are poisoned until a good player dies by execution.
role.blood-on-the-blocktower.amnesiac.ab: You do not know what your ability is. Each day, privately guess what it is: you learn how accurate you are.
role.blood-on-the-blocktower.farmer.abil: When you die at night, an alive good player becomes a Farmer.
role.blood-on-the-blocktower.choirboy.ab: If the Demon kills the King, you learn which player is the Demon. [+the King]
role.blood-on-the-blocktower.magician.ab: The Demon thinks you are a Minion. Minions think you are a Demon.
role.blood-on-the-blocktower.poppygrower: Minions & Demons do not know each other. If you die, they learn who each other are that night.
role.blood-on-the-blocktower.atheist.abi: The Storyteller can break the game rules, and if executed, good wins, even if you are dead. [No evil characters]
role.blood-on-the-blocktower.knight.abil: You start knowing 2 players that are not the Demon.
role.blood-on-the-blocktower.shugenja.ab: You start knowing if your closest evil player is clockwise or anti-clockwise. If equidistant, this info is arbitrary.
role.blood-on-the-blocktower.bountyhunte: You start knowing 1 evil player. If the player you know dies, you learn another evil player tonight. [1 Townsfolk is evil]
role.blood-on-the-blocktower.highprieste: Each night, learn which player the Storyteller believes you should talk to most.
Each night, you learn a player of a different character type than last night. [+0 or +1 Outsider]
role.blood-on-the-blocktower.preacher.ab: Each night, choose a player: a Minion, if chosen, learns this. All chosen Minions have no ability.
role.blood-on-the-blocktower.villageidio: Each night, choose a player: you learn their alignment. [+0 to +2 Village Idiots. 1 of the extras is drunk]
Each night, you become the alignment of an alive neighbor. If all good players choose to join your cult, your team wins.
role.blood-on-the-blocktower.acrobat.abi: Each night*, choose a player: if they are or become drunk or poisoned tonight, you die.
role.blood-on-the-blocktower.alsaahir.ab: Each day, if you publicly guess which players are Minion(s) and which are Demon(s), good wins.
role.blood-on-the-blocktower.nightwatchm: Once per game, at night, choose a player: they learn you are the Nightwatchman.
role.blood-on-the-blocktower.fisherman.a: Once per game, at night, ask the Storyteller for some advice to help your team win.
role.blood-on-the-blocktower.princess.ab: On your 1st day, if you nominated & executed a player, the Demon doesn't kill tonight.
role.blood-on-the-blocktower.banshee.abi: If the Demon kills you, all players learn this. From now on, you may nominate twice per day and vote twice per nomination.
role.blood-on-the-blocktower.butler.abil: Each night, choose a player (not yourself): tomorrow, you may only vote if they are voting too.
role.blood-on-the-blocktower.saint.abili: If you die by execution, your team loses.
role.blood-on-the-blocktower.recluse.abi: You might register as evil & as a Minion or Demon, even if dead.
role.blood-on-the-blocktower.drunk.abili: You do not know you are the Drunk. You think you are a Townsfolk character, but you are not.
role.blood-on-the-blocktower.goon.abilit: Each night, the 1st player to choose you with their ability is drunk until dusk.You become their alignment.
role.blood-on-the-blocktower.lunatic.abi: You think you are a Demon, but you are not. The Demon knows who you are & who you choose at night.
role.blood-on-the-blocktower.tinker.abil: You might die at any time.
role.blood-on-the-blocktower.moonchild.a: When you learn that you died, publicly choose 1 alive player. Tonight, if it was a good player, they die.
role.blood-on-the-blocktower.mutant.abil: If you are "mad" about being an Outsider, you might be executed.
role.blood-on-the-blocktower.barber.abil: If you died today or tonight, the Demon may choose 2 players (not another Demon) to swap characters.
When you die, 1 player is drunk from now on.
role.blood-on-the-blocktower.klutz.abili: When you learn that you died, publicly choose 1 alive player: if they are evil, your team loses.
role.blood-on-the-blocktower.golem.abili: You may only nominate once per game. When you do, if the nominee is not the Demon, they die.
role.blood-on-the-blocktower.damsel.abil: All Minions know a Damsel is in play. If a Minion publicly guesses you (once), your team loses.
role.blood-on-the-blocktower.heretic.abi: Whoever wins, loses & whoever loses, wins, even if you are dead.
role.blood-on-the-blocktower.puzzlemaste: 1 player is drunk, even if you die. If you guess (once) who it is, learn the Demon player, but guess wrong & get false info.
role.blood-on-the-blocktower.hermit.abil: You have all Outsider abilities. [-0 or -1 Outsider]
role.blood-on-the-blocktower.ogre.abilit: On your 1st night, choose a player (not yourself): you become their alignment (you don't know which) even if drunk or poisoned.
role.blood-on-the-blocktower.plaguedocto: When you die, the Storyteller gains a Minion ability.
role.blood-on-the-blocktower.hatter.abil: If you died today or tonight, the Minion & Demon players may choose new Minion & Demon characters to be.
If you were the player most responsible for your team losing, you change alignment & win, even if dead.
role.blood-on-the-blocktower.zealot.abil: If there are 5 or more players alive, you must vote for every nomination.
role.blood-on-the-blocktower.poisoner.ab: Each night, choose a player: they are poisoned tonight and tomorrow day.
role.blood-on-the-blocktower.spy.ability: Each night, you see the Grimoire. You might register as good & as a Townsfolk or Outsider, even if dead.
role.blood-on-the-blocktower.baron.abili: There are extra Outsiders in play. [+2 Outsiders]
role.blood-on-the-blocktower.scarletwoma: If there are 5 or more players alive & the Demon dies, you become the Demon.
role.blood-on-the-blocktower.godfather.a: You start knowing which Outsiders are in play. If 1 died today, choose a player tonight: they die. [-1 or +1 Outsider]
role.blood-on-the-blocktower.devilsadvoc: Each night, choose a living player (different to last night): if executed tomorrow, they don't die.
role.blood-on-the-blocktower.assassin.ab: Once per game, at night*, choose a player: they die, even if for some reason they could not.
If the Demon dies by execution (ending the game), play for 1 more day. If a player is then executed, their team loses.
role.blood-on-the-blocktower.witch.abili: Each night, choose a player: if they nominate tomorrow, they die. If just 3 players live, you lose this ability.
role.blood-on-the-blocktower.cerenovus.a: Each night, choose a player & a good character: they are "mad" they are this character tomorrow, or might be executed.
role.blood-on-the-blocktower.pithag.abil: Each night*, choose a player & a character they become (if not in play). If a Demon is made, deaths tonight are arbitrary.
role.blood-on-the-blocktower.eviltwin.ab: You & an opposing player know each other. If the good player is executed, evil wins. Good can't win if you both live.
You start knowing a secret word. The 1st good player to say this word becomes evil that night.
Each night, choose a player: if you nominate & execute them, their team loses. All players know if you choose a new player.
Each day, before nominations, you may publicly choose a player: they die. If executed, you only die if you lose roshambo.
You think you are a good character, but you are not. The Demon knows who you are. [You neighbor the Demon]
role.blood-on-the-blocktower.boomdandy.a: If you are executed, all but 3 players die. After a 10 to 1 countdown, the player with the most players pointing at them, dies.
role.blood-on-the-blocktower.harpy.abili: Each night, choose 2 players: tomorrow, the 1st player is mad that the 2nd is evil, or one or both might die.
role.blood-on-the-blocktower.wizard.abil: Once per game, choose to make a wish. If granted, it might have a price & leave a clue as to its nature.
role.blood-on-the-blocktower.widow.abili: On your 1st night, look at the Grimoire & choose a player: they are poisoned. 1 good player knows a Widow is in play.
role.blood-on-the-blocktower.xaan.abilit: On night X, all Townsfolk are poisoned until dusk. [X Outsiders]
role.blood-on-the-blocktower.wraith.abil: You may choose to visit other players at night. You visit other evil players when they wake.
role.blood-on-the-blocktower.summoner.ab: You get 3 bluffs. On the 3rd night, choose a player: they become an evil Demon of your choice. [No Demon]
role.blood-on-the-blocktower.goblin.abil: If you publicly claim to be the Goblin when nominated & are executed that day, your team wins.
role.blood-on-the-blocktower.vizier.abil: All players know you are the Vizier. You cannot die during the day. If good voted, you may choose to execute immediately.
role.blood-on-the-blocktower.organgrinde: All players keep their eyes closed when voting and the vote tally is secret. Each night, choose if you are drunk until dusk.
role.blood-on-the-blocktower.boffin.abil: The Demon (even if drunk or poisoned) has a not-in-play good character's ability. You both know which.
role.blood-on-the-blocktower.imp.ability: Each night*, choose a player: they die. If you kill yourself this way, a Minion becomes the Imp.
role.blood-on-the-blocktower.pukka.abili: Each night, choose a player: they are poisoned. The previously poisoned player dies then becomes healthy.
role.blood-on-the-blocktower.shabaloth.a: Each night*, choose 2 players: they die. A dead player you chose last night might be regurgitated.
role.blood-on-the-blocktower.po.ability: Each night*, you may choose a player: they die. If your last choice was no-one, choose 3 players tonight.
role.blood-on-the-blocktower.zombuul.abi: Each night*, if no-one died today, choose a player: they die. The 1st time you die, you live but register as dead.
role.blood-on-the-blocktower.fanggu.abil: Each night*, choose a player: they die. The 1st Outsider this kills becomes an evil Fang Gu & you die instead. [+1 Outsider]
role.blood-on-the-blocktower.vigormortis: Each night*, choose a player: they die. Minions you kill keep their ability & poison 1 Townsfolk neighbor. [-1 Outsider]
role.blood-on-the-blocktower.nodashii.ab: Each night*, choose a player: they die. Your 2 Townsfolk neighbors are poisoned.
role.blood-on-the-blocktower.vortox.abil: Each night*, choose a player: they die. Townsfolk abilities yield false info. Each day, if no-one is executed, evil wins.
role.blood-on-the-blocktower.legion.abil: Each night*, a player might die. Executions fail if only evil voted. You register as a Minion too. [Most players are Legion]
role.blood-on-the-blocktower.lleech.abil: Each night*, choose a player: they die. You start by choosing a player: they are poisoned. You die if & only if they are dead.
Each night*, you may choose 3 players (all players learn who): each silently chooses to live or die, but if all live, all die.
role.blood-on-the-blocktower.riot.abilit: On day 3, Minions become Riot & nominees die but nominate an alive player immediately. This must happen.
role.blood-on-the-blocktower.leviathan.a: If more than 1 good player is executed, evil wins. All players know you are in play. After day 5, evil wins.
role.blood-on-the-blocktower.yaggababble: You start knowing a secret phrase. For each time you said it publicly today, a player might die.
role.blood-on-the-blocktower.lilmonsta.a: Each night, Minions choose who babysits Lil' Monsta & "is the Demon". Each night*, a player might die. [+1 Minion]
role.blood-on-the-blocktower.kazali.abil: Each night*, choose a player: they die. [You choose which players are which Minions. -? to +? Outsiders]
role.blood-on-the-blocktower.ojo.ability: Each night*, choose a character: they die. If they are not in play, the Storyteller chooses who dies.
role.blood-on-the-blocktower.lordoftypho: Each night*, choose a player: they die. [Evil characters are in a line. You are in the middle. +1 Minion. -? to +? Outsiders]
role.blood-on-the-blocktower.thief.abili: Each night, choose a player (not yourself): their vote counts negatively tomorrow.
Each night, choose a player (not yourself): their vote counts as 3 votes tomorrow.
Each day, after the 1st vote has been tallied, you may choose a player that voted: they die.
role.blood-on-the-blocktower.scapegoat.a: If a player of your alignment is executed, you might be executed instead.
role.blood-on-the-blocktower.beggar.abil: You must use a vote token to vote. If a dead player gives you theirs, you learn their alignment. You are sober & healthy.
On your 1st night, you gain a Townsfolk ability (if good), or a Minion ability (if evil).
role.blood-on-the-blocktower.matron.abil: Each day, you may choose up to 3 sets of 2 players to swap seats. Players may not leave their seats to talk in private.
role.blood-on-the-blocktower.judge.abili: Once per game, if another player nominated, you may choose to force the current execution to pass or fail.
role.blood-on-the-blocktower.voudon.abil: Only you & the dead can vote. They don't need a vote token to do so. A 50% majority isn't required.
role.blood-on-the-blocktower.bishop.abil: Only the Storyteller can nominate. At least 1 opposing player must be nominated each day.
role.blood-on-the-blocktower.barista.abi: Each night, until dusk, 1) a player becomes sober, healthy & gets true info, or 2) their ability works twice. They learn which.
role.blood-on-the-blocktower.harlot.abil: Each night*, choose a living player: if they agree, you learn their character, but you both might die.
role.blood-on-the-blocktower.butcher.abi: Each day, after the 1st execution, you may nominate again.
role.blood-on-the-blocktower.deviant.abi: If you were funny today, you cannot die by exile.
role.blood-on-the-blocktower.bonecollect: Once per game, at night*, choose a dead player: they regain their ability until dusk.
Each day, choose a player: a different player changes character tonight.
role.blood-on-the-blocktower.gangster.ab: Once per day, you may choose to kill an alive neighbor, if your other alive neighbor agrees.
role.blood-on-the-blocktower.gnome.abili: All players start knowing a player of your alignment. You may choose to kill anyone who nominates them.
role.blood-on-the-blocktower.angel.abili: Something bad might happen to whoever is most responsible for the death of a new player.
role.blood-on-the-blocktower.buddhist.ab: For the first 2 minutes of each day, veteran players may not talk.
role.blood-on-the-blocktower.deusexfiasc: At least once per game, the Storyteller will make a mistake, correct it, and publicly admit to it.
role.blood-on-the-blocktower.djinn.abili: Use the Djinn's special rule. All players know what it is.
role.blood-on-the-blocktower.doomsayer.a: If 4 or more players live, each living player may publicly choose (once per game) that a player of their own alignment dies.
role.blood-on-the-blocktower.duchess.abi: Each day, 3 players may choose to visit you. At night*, each visitor learns how many visitors are evil, but 1 gets false info.
role.blood-on-the-blocktower.ferryman.ab: On the final day, all dead players regain their vote token.
role.blood-on-the-blocktower.fibbin.abil: Once per game, 1 good player might get incorrect information.
role.blood-on-the-blocktower.fiddler.abi: Once per game, the Demon secretly chooses an opposing player: all players choose which of these 2 players win.
role.blood-on-the-blocktower.hellslibrar: Something bad might happen to whoever talks when the Storyteller has asked for silence.
role.blood-on-the-blocktower.revolutiona: 2 neighboring players are known to be the same alignment. Once per game, 1 of them registers falsely.
role.blood-on-the-blocktower.sentinel.ab: There might be 1 extra or 1 fewer Outsider in play.
role.blood-on-the-blocktower.spiritofivo: There can't be more than 1 extra evil player.
role.blood-on-the-blocktower.toymaker.ab: The Demon may choose not to attack & must do this at least once per game. Evil players get normal starting info.
role.blood-on-the-blocktower.bigwig.abil: Each nominee chooses a player: until voting, only they may speak & they are mad the nominee is good or they might die.
This script has homebrew characters or rules.
role.blood-on-the-blocktower.gardener.ab: The Storyteller assigns 1 or more players' characters.
role.blood-on-the-blocktower.godofug.abi: One Ug hat. When wear Ug hat, must speak one sound at a time but vote twice. If fail, pass Ug hat.
role.blood-on-the-blocktower.hindu.abili: The first 4 players to die are immediately reincarnated as Travellers of the same alignment.
role.blood-on-the-blocktower.knaves.abil: There are 2 Storytellers: one lies & one tells the truth. Once per game, at dusk, they might switch.
role.blood-on-the-blocktower.pope.abilit: There are duplicate good characters in play. They might also be bluffs.
role.blood-on-the-blocktower.stormcatche: Name a good character. If in play, they can only die by execution, but evil players learn which player it is.
role.blood-on-the-blocktower.tor.ability: Players don't know their character or alignment. They learn them when they die.
role.blood-on-the-blocktower.ventriloqui: If a player is mad as a fresh character during their nomination, they might not die if executed today.
One or more players each have a goal. When achieved, that player learns a piece of true info.
